records.name: Acropolis
records.summary: A district unique to Greece for cultural sites. Replaces the Theater Square district and cheaper to build. Awards 1 Envoy Envoy when completed. +1 Culture Culture bonus for each adjacent district and an additional +1 Culture Culture bonus for adjacent City Center. +2 Culture Culture bonus for each adjacent wonder, Entertainment Complex, and Water Park. Can only be built on Hills.

records.name: Advanced AI
records.summary: Unlocks Giant Death Robot upgrade: Drone Air Defense +100 Antiair Large Anti-Air Strength.

records.name: Advanced Power Cells
records.summary: CO2 emissions from units reduced by 50%. Unlocks Giant Death Robot upgrade: Particle Beam Siege Cannon Ranged attacks against Cities and Encampments are 100% effective and gain +30 Ranged Ranged Strength.

records.name: Aerodrome
records.summary: A district that allows you to build and store aircraft. Cannot be built on Hills.

records.name: Aircraft Carrier
records.summary: Atomic era melee naval unit that can transport air units.

records.name: Airport
records.summary: +50% combat experience for air units trained in this city. +1 air unit slot in Aerodrome district. Allows the ability to airlift land units between Aerodrome districts with Airports after the Rapid Deployment civic is unlocked.

records.name: Airstrip
records.summary: Unlocks the Military Engineer ability to construct an Airstrip. Can support 3 air units. Can only be built on flat terrain. -1 Appeal.

records.name: Alchemical Society
records.summary: Unique to the Hermetic Order, replaces the University. This Campus district generates Gold Gold equal to its Science Science adjacency bonus.

records.name: Alhambra
records.summary: +1 Military policy slot Provides the same defensive bonuses as the Fort improvement. Must be built on Hills adjacent to an Encampment district.

records.name: Amundsen-Scott Research Station
records.summary: +20% Science Science and 10% Production Production in all cities. If there are 5 Snow or Snow Hills tiles within 3 tiles of a city and owned by this player these yields are doubled. Must be built next to a Campus with a Research Lab on a Snow or Snow Hills tile.

records.name: Anansi
records.summary: Demigod and traveler of African folklore, renowned for his wit and trickery.

records.name: Ancestral Hall
records.summary: 50% increased Production Production toward Settlers in this City. New cities receive a free Builder. Awards +1 Governor Governor Title.

records.name: Ancient Walls
records.summary: Provides Walls around the City Center and Encampment district. Walls allow Ranged Ranged Strikes from the City Center and Encampment district, and must be defeated before a city can be assaulted. Provides 1 Tourism Tourism after advancing to the Conservation Civic.

records.name: Angkor Wat
records.summary: +1 Citizen Population in all Current Cities when built. +1 Housing Housing in all cities.  Must be built adjacent to an Aqueduct district.

records.name: Animal Husbandry
records.summary: Allows harvesting of Resource Cattle Cattle, Resource Sheep Sheep, and Resource Deer Deer.

records.name: Anti-Air Gun
records.summary: Atomic era anti-air support unit. Provides cover from air attacks up to 1 hex away from the weapon.

records.name: Apadana
records.summary: +2 Envoy Envoys when you build a wonder, including Apadana, in this city. Must be built adjacent to your Capital Capital.

records.name: Apostle
records.summary: May convert Citizen Citizens to their Religion and initiate theological combat with units of other Religions. Once per game may Launch Inquisition to allow the purchase of Inquisitors. Once per game may Evangelize Belief to add an additional Belief to their Religion. These uses consume the Apostle.

records.name: Apprenticeship
records.summary: A major production breakpoint because it unlocks Industrial Zones and improves the value of Mine-heavy cities.

records.name: Aquarium
records.summary: Bonus Amenities Amenity extends to each city center within 9 tiles. This bonus applies once to a city, and multiple copies of this building within 9 tiles of a city center do not provide additional bonuses. +1 Science Science to each coastal resource, Shipwreck, and Reef tile in this city.

records.name: Aquatics Center
records.summary: Bonus Amenities Amenities extend to each city center within 9 tiles. This bonus applies once to a city, and multiple copies of this building within 9 tiles of a city center do not provide additional bonuses. +2 Tourism Tourism for each Wonder built in this city on or adjacent to a Coast tile.

records.name: Aqueduct
records.summary: A district that provides this city with a source of fresh water from an adjacent River, Lake, Oasis, or Mountain. Cities that do not yet have existing fresh water receive up to 6 Housing Housing. Cities that already have existing fresh water will instead get +2 Housing Housing. If built adjacent to a Geothermal Fissure +1 Amenities Amenity. Prevents Food Food loss during Drought. Must be built adjacent to the City Center. Military Engineers can spend a charge to complete 20% of an Aqueduct's production.

records.name: Archaeological Museum
records.summary: Holds Greatwork Artifact Artifacts. May not be built in a Theater Square district that already has an Art Museum.

records.name: Archaeologist
records.summary: Find and extract Greatwork Artifact Artifacts from Resource Antiquity Site Antiquity Sites to be displayed in their home city's Museum.

records.name: Archer
records.summary: First Ancient era ranged unit with a Range Range of 2.

records.name: Arena
records.summary: Provides 1 Tourism Tourism after advancing to the Conservation Civic.

records.name: Armory
records.summary: +25% combat experience for all land units trained in this city. Strategic Resource Stockpiles increased +10 (on Standard Speed).

records.name: Art Museum
records.summary: Holds Greatwork Landscape Great Works of Art. May not be built in a Theater Square district that already has an Archaeological Museum.

records.name: Arthur
records.summary: King and founder of the Knights of the Round Table, renowned for his virtue and chivalry.

records.name: Artillery
records.summary: Modern era siege unit, ideal for attacking cities. Cannot move and attack on the same turn unless they've earned the Expert Crew promotion.

records.name: AT Crew
records.summary: Modern era counter to cavalry class units.

records.name: Audience Chamber
records.summary: +2 Amenities Amenities and +4 Housing Housing in Cities with Governor Governors -2 Loyalty in Cities without Governor Governors. Awards +1 Governor Governor Title.

records.name: Autocracy
records.summary: Useful when concentrating early output or competing for wonders.

records.name: Banking
records.summary: +2 Gold Gold from the Quarry improvement.

records.name: Barbarian Outpost
records.summary: Creates additional Barbarians.Gold Gold award if destroyed. -1 Appeal

records.name: Barbary Corsair
records.summary: Ottoman unique Medieval era naval unit that replaces the Privateer. It costs no Movement Movement to coastal raid. Can only be seen by other Naval Raiders unless adjacent to it. Reveals Naval Raiders within sight range.

records.name: Barracks
records.summary: +25% combat experience for all melee and ranged land units trained in this city. Strategic Resource Stockpiles increased +10 (on Standard Speed). May not be built in an Encampment district that already has a Stable.

records.name: Barricade
records.summary: An unworkable early Improvement that deals minor damage to, and exerts zone of control on, hostile units passing through or adjacent to it. Unlocked with Military Engineering and built using a Builder Charge. Does not prevent unit movement through this space.

records.name: Basilikoi Paides
records.summary: A building unique to Macedon.+25% combat experience for all melee, ranged land units, and Hetairoi trained in this city. Gain Science Science equal to 25% of the unit's cost when a non civilian unit is created in this city. Strategic Resource Stockpiles increased +10 (on Standard Speed). May not be built in an Encampment district that already has a Stable.

records.name: Batey
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Batey. +1 Culture Culture. +1 Culture Culture for every adjacent Bonus Resource and Entertainment Complex (increased to +2 Culture Culture when Exploration is discovered). Provides Tourism Tourism after researching Flight. Cannot be built adjacent to another Batey or on Hills.

records.name: Bath
records.summary: Helps Roman cities keep growing while easing pressure on Amenities and fresh-water placement.

records.name: Battering Ram
records.summary: Ancient era support unit. When adjacent to a city, attacking melee and anti-cavalry units do full damage to the city’s Walls. Does not affect cities with Medieval or Renaissance Walls. Ineffective against Urban Defenses.

records.name: Battleship
records.summary: Modern era naval ranged unit. Provides cover from air and nuclear attacks up to 1 tile away.

records.name: Beowulf
records.summary: Mighty warrior of the far North, renowned for his strength and bravery in single combat.

records.name: Berserker
records.summary: Norwegian unique Medieval era melee unit that replaces the Man-At-Arms. 4 Movement Movement if this unit starts in enemy territory. +10 Strength Combat Strength when attacking and -5 Strength Combat Strength when defending against melee attacks.

records.name: Big Ben
records.summary: +1 Economic policy slot Immediately after construction Gold Gold in treasury is increased by 50%. Must be built next to a River adjacent to a Commercial Hub district with a Bank.

records.name: Biosphère
records.summary: +200% Power Power for all Offshore Windfarms, Solar Farms, Wind Farms, Geothermal Plants, and Hydroelectric Dams. This building and these improvements provide Tourism Tourism equal to their Power Power. +1 Appeal to tiles adjacent to Rainforest and Marsh in your empire. Must be built along a River adjacent to a Neighborhood district.

records.name: Biplane
records.summary: First air combat unit, available in the Modern era.

records.name: Bireme
records.summary: Phoenician unique Ancient Era unit that replaces the Galley. Increased Strength Combat Strength and Movement Movement. Trader units are immune to being plundered if they are within 4 tiles of a Bireme and on a water tile.

records.name: Black Army
records.summary: Hungarian unique Medieval Era unit that replaces the Courser. +3 Strength Combat Strength for each adjacent Levied unit.

records.name: Bolshoi Theatre
records.summary: Awards 2 randomly-chosen free civics when completed. Must be built on flat land adjacent to a Theater Square district.

records.name: Bombard
records.summary: Renaissance era siege unit, ideal for attacking cities. Cannot move and attack on the same turn unless they've earned the Expert Crew promotion.

records.name: Bomber
records.summary: First bomber unit, available in the Atomic era.

records.name: Broadway
records.summary: +20% Culture Culture in this city. 1 free random Atomic era civic boost. Must be built on flat land adjacent to a Theater Square district.

records.name: Bronze Working
records.summary: Revealing Iron early helps you plan settlements, military timing, and tile improvements before rivals claim it.

records.name: Builder
records.summary: May create tile improvements, remove features like Woods or Rainforest, or Harvest some resources. Builders can be used 3 times. This can be increased through policies or wonders like the Pyramids.

records.name: Cahokia Mounds
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Cahokia Mounds. +3 Gold Gold. Cities receive +1 Amenities Amenity from their first Cahokia Mound improvement. Upon discovering Natural History, cities receive +1 Amenities Amenity from their second Cahokia Mound improvement. +1 Food Food for every 2 adjacent Districts once Feudalism is discovered or for every adjacent District once Replaceable Parts is researched. Provides +1 Housing Housing. Receive an additional Housing Housing once Cultural Heritage is discovered. Cannot be built adjacent to other Cahokia Mounds.

records.name: Camp
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct Camps. +2 Gold Gold. Can only be built on valid resources. If built on Luxury resources, the city will gain use of that resource.

records.name: Canal
records.summary: A district built on flat land to connect two bodies of water or a body of water to a City Center. Traderoute Trade Routes traveling through it can multiply the Gold Gold they get from districts at their destination. Canals may either go straight through the hex or bend by 60 degrees. However three-way Canal junctures are not allowed and Canals must have a full land tile on each side of the waterway they create. Military Engineers can spend a charge to complete 20% of a Canal's production.

records.name: Caravel
records.summary: Fast Renaissance era exploration melee naval unit.

records.name: Carolean
records.summary: Swedish unique Renaissance Era unit that replaces the Pike and Shot. Faster than the Pike and Shot. +3 Strength Combat Strength per unused Movement Movement.

records.name: Cartography
records.summary: +2 Gold Gold from the Fishing Boat improvement. All naval and embarked units can navigate Ocean tiles.

records.name: Casa de Contratación
records.summary: Gain 3 Governor Governor promotions. All your cities not on your original Capital Capital's continent with a Governor Governor gain +15% Production Production, +15% Faith Faith and +15% Gold Gold. Must be built adjacent to a Government Plaza.

records.name: Castles
records.summary: Bonus Culture Culture for the Great Wall improvement for adjacency. Gain a free Spy if playing as Catherine de Medici (Black Queen).

records.name: Catapult
records.summary: Classical era siege unit, ideal for attacking cities. Cannot move and attack on the same turn unless they've earned the Expert Crew promotion.

records.name: Cavalry
records.summary: Fast-moving Industrial era light cavalry unit.

records.name: Celestial Navigation
records.summary: Allows Traders to embark, and allows harvesting of Resource Fish Fish and Resource Crabs Crabs.

records.name: Chancery
records.summary: +3 Influence Points per turn. When this civilization captures or kills an enemy Spy, receive 50 Science Science for every level of the enemy Spy.

records.name: Chemamull
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Chemamull, unique to Mapuche. +1 Production Production. Provides Culture Culture equal to 75% of the tile's Appeal. Additional Tourism Tourism after researching Flight. Minimum Appeal of Breathtaking.

records.name: Chichen Itza
records.summary: +2 Culture Culture to all Rainforest tiles for this city. +1 Production Production to all Rainforest tiles for this city. Must be built on Rainforest.

records.name: Château
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Château, unique to France. +2 Culture Culture and +1 Gold Gold. +1 Appeal. +1 Culture Culture for every adjacent wonder (becomes +2 after researching Flight). +2 Gold Gold if on a tile containing a River edge. Provides Tourism Tourism from Culture Culture after researching Flight. Must be placed adjacent to a Bonus or Luxury resource. Cannot be built adjacent to another Château.

records.name: City Park
records.summary: A Governor Governor unique improvement that can be built in a city with a Surveyor Governor with the Parks and Recreation promotion. Yields 2 Appeal and 1 Culture Culture. +1 Amenities Amenity if adjacent to water. +3 Culture Culture if in a city with a Surveyor Governor with the Parks and Recreation promotion. Cannot be adjacent to another City Park.

records.name: Civil Engineering
records.summary: Can build Farms on Grassland Hills and Plains Hills.

records.name: Classical Republic
records.summary: Supports district-led development and flexible economic policy use.

records.name: Coal Power Plant
records.summary: Automatically converts any amount of Resource Coal Coal into Power Power for cities within 6 tiles that need it each turn, at the rate of: Bullet1 Resource Coal Coal Powerright 4 Power Power BulletHeavy CO2 into the atmosphere

records.name: Code of Laws
records.summary: Your first policy choices define whether the opening emphasizes production, Faith, or protection from Barbarians.

records.name: Cold War
records.summary: Grants the ability to construct an additional Spy.

records.name: Colonialism
records.summary: The Fishing Boats improvement receives +1 Production Production.

records.name: Colossal Head
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Colossal Head. +2 Faith Faith. +1 Faith Faith for every 2 adjacent Rainforest or for every adjacent Rainforest once Humanism is discovered. +1 Faith Faith for every 2 adjacent Woods or for every adjacent Woods once Humanism is discovered. Tourism Tourism from Faith Faith once Flight is researched. Cannot be built on Snow or Snow Hills.

records.name: Colosseum
records.summary: The Colosseum provides 2 of the following: Culture Culture, Loyalty per turn, and Amenities Amenities to each city center within 6 tiles. Must be built on flat land adjacent to an Entertainment Complex with an Arena.

records.name: Colossus
records.summary: +1 Traderoute Trade Route capacity. Grants a Trader unit. Must be built on the Coast, adjacent to land and a Harbor district.

records.name: Comandante General
records.summary: A special type of Great Person only available to Simón Bolívar. Each has unique abilities, including a passive effect, and a Retire effect.

records.name: Commercial Hub
records.summary: Supports Gold income, trade capacity, and Great Merchants.

records.name: Computers
records.summary: Grants the ability to construct an additional Spy. +25% Tourism Tourism across your empire.

records.name: Conquistador
records.summary: Spanish unique Renaissance era unit that replaces the Musketman. +10 Strength Combat Strength when there is a religious unit within one hex. If this unit captures a city or is adjacent to a city when it is captured, the city will automatically adopt the Conquistador player's Religion as the dominant Religion.

records.name: Conservation
records.summary: Awards 3 Envoy Envoys. Allows the building of National Parks and the purchase of Naturalists with Faith Faith. Allows Builders to plant Woods (second-growth). Woods in your territory that have never been removed (old-growth) gain +1 Appeal. Receive Tourism Tourism from Walls.

records.name: Consulate
records.summary: +2 Influence Points per turn. Enemy Spy's level is reduced by 1 when targeting this city or cities with Encampments.

records.name: Copacabana
records.summary: A district unique to Brazil. Replaces the Water Park district, and provides +2 Amenities Amenities. Also unlocks the Carnival project, which grants an additional +1 Amenities Amenity when underway and a variety of Greatperson Great People points once completed. Cannot be built in a city with a Street Carnival. Cannot be built on Reef.

records.name: Corporation
records.summary: A corporation dedicated to a specific Luxury Resource. Allows cities to create Products, a new type of Great Work which grants powerful bonuses to your cities that house them. Can only be pillaged (never destroyed) by natural disasters.

records.name: Cossack
records.summary: Russian unique Industrial era unit that replaces Cavalry. Stronger than Cavalry, and gains +5 Strength Combat Strength when fighting in or adjacent to its home territory. Can move after attacking if Movement Movement points remain.

records.name: Cothon
records.summary: A district unique to Phoenicia for naval activity in your city. Replaces the Harbor district and cheaper to build. Must be built on Coast or Lake Terrain adjacent to land. +50% Production Production towards naval units and Settlers in this city. All wounded naval units in this city’s borders heal +100 HP each turn.

records.name: Cristo Redentor
records.summary: Tourism Tourism output from Greatwork Relic Relics and Holy Cities is not diminished by other civilizations who have researched The Enlightenment civic. +100% Tourism Tourism from Seaside Resorts across your civilization. Must be built on Hills.

records.name: Crouching Tiger
records.summary: Chinese unique Medieval era unit. Ranged unit with a Range Range of 1 and high combat strength.

records.name: Cultist
records.summary: Support unit unique to the Voidsingers. Once it dies or loses all charges, its devoted sacrifice awards the player a Greatwork Relic Relic of the Void. Can move into foreign lands when not at war, and use a charge to Recruit Followers in an adjacent foreign city, causing it to lose 10 Loyalty.

records.name: Cybernetics
records.summary: Unlocks Giant Death Robot upgrade: Enhanced Mobility +3 Movement Movement. Can perform a Jump action to cross over mountain terrain.

records.name: Dam
records.summary: A district built on a Floodplains tile to improve the comfort of living along this river. Prevents damage from flooding of this river (though yields from flooding drop by 50%). Prevents Food Food loss during Drought. Only one may be built along each river's floodplain (whichever player completes one first) and the river must traverse at least two sides of the Dam hex. Military Engineers can spend a charge to complete 20% of a Dam's production.

records.name: Dar-e Mehr
records.summary: +1 additional Faith Faith for each era since constructed or last repaired. Cannot be pillaged by natural disasters.

records.name: De Zeven Provinciën
records.summary: Netherlands unique Renaissance Era unit that replaces the Frigate. +7 Strength Combat Strength when attacking defensible districts.

records.name: Destroyer
records.summary: Strongest melee naval unit. Reveals Naval Raiders within sight range.

records.name: Diamonds
records.summary: A valuable Gold tile whose first improved copy also supports Amenities.

records.name: Digger
records.summary: Australian unique Modern era unit that replaces Infantry. +10 Strength Combat Strength when fighting on Coastal tiles. +5 Strength Combat Strength when fighting on Neutral or Foreign Territory.

records.name: Diplomatic Quarter
records.summary: Your civilization receives +1 Favor Diplomatic Favor for each Delegation or Embassy from a foreign civilization through diplomacy. +1 Envoy Envoy if built next to the city center. Enemy Spies operate at 2 levels below normal targeting this district and adjacent districts. Only 1 can exist in your empire at a time.

records.name: Diplomatic Service
records.summary: Grants the ability to construct a Spy.

records.name: Discipline
records.summary: Use it when Barbarian camps or raiders threaten your opening; replace it when that pressure is gone.

records.name: Domrey
records.summary: Khmer unique Medieval era siege unit that replaces the Trebuchet. This unit has a higher Strength Melee and Range Strength than the Trebuchet. It can move and shoot in the same turn and exerts zone of control.

records.name: Dromon
records.summary: Byzantine unique Classical era unit that replaces the Quadrireme that has additional range and receives +10 Strength Combat Strength against units.

records.name: Drone
records.summary: Atomic era support unit. Adds +1 Range Range and +5 Bombard Bombard Strength to Siege class units within 1 hex.

records.name: Eagle Warrior
records.summary: Aztec unique Ancient era unit that replaces the Warrior. Has a chance to capture other civilization's military units by turning them into Builders.

records.name: Early Empire
records.summary: Unlocks the abilities to enforce borders and grant Open Borders to other civilizations.

records.name: Eiffel Tower
records.summary: All tiles in your civilization gain +2 Appeal. Must be built on flat land adjacent to the City Center.

records.name: Electronics Factory
records.summary: A building unique to Japan. Provides +4 Culture Culture to this city after researching the Electricity technology. Its Production Production bonus is extended to all City Centers within 6 tiles that do not already have a bonus from this building type.

records.name: Encampment
records.summary: A district in your city for military facilities.

records.name: Entertainment Complex
records.summary: A district in your city dedicated to keeping your people happy by increasing Amenities Amenities. Cannot be built in a city with a Water Park.

records.name: Estádio do Maracanã
records.summary: +2 Amenities Amenities in each city in your civilization. Must be built on flat land adjacent to an Entertainment Complex district with a Stadium.

records.name: Etemenanki
records.summary: +2 Science Science and +1 Production Production to all Marsh tiles in your empire. +1 Science Science and +1 Production Production on all Floodplains tiles for this city. Must be built on Floodplains or Marsh.

records.name: Factory
records.summary: Its Production Production bonus is extended to all City Centers within 6 tiles that do not already have a bonus from this building type.

records.name: Farm
records.summary: Supports growth and later Farm adjacency patterns.

records.name: Feitoria
records.summary: Unlocks the Nau ability to construct a Feitoria, unique to Portugal. Provides +4 Gold Gold and +1 Production Production. Trade routes sent to this city from Portugal gain +4 Gold Gold and +1 Production Production. Can only be built adjacent to Luxury or Bonus resources in territory belonging to other Civilizations or City-States that you have Open Borders with. Must be built on a Coast or Lake tile adjacent to land and not adjacent to another Feitoria. Feitorias cannot be removed.

records.name: Feudalism
records.summary: Farm improvements now gain +1 Food Food from every 2 adjacent Farm improvements. Plantation improvements receive +1 Food Food.

records.name: Film Studio
records.summary: A building unique to America. +100% Tourism Tourism pressure from this city towards other civilizations when the game enters the Modern era.

records.name: Fishery
records.summary: A Governor Governor unique improvement that can be built in a city with a Surveyor Governor with the Aquaculture promotion. Yields 1 Food Food, +0.5 Housing Housing, +1 additional Food Food if adjacent to a sea resource. +1 Production Production if in a city with a Surveyor Governor with the Aquaculture promotion. Must be built on a coastal plot.

records.name: Fishing Boats
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct Fishing Boats. +1 Food Food. Can only be built on valid resources. If built on Luxury resources, the city will gain use of that resource.

records.name: Flight
records.summary: Receive Tourism Tourism on all improvements that provide Culture Culture. Amount of Tourism Tourism generated is equivalent to the improvement's Culture Culture output.

records.name: Flood Barrier
records.summary: Protects Coastal Lowland tiles in this city from flooding. Initial build cost and per turn maintenance are variable based on the number of Coastal Lowlands in this city and the current sea level. If constructed after some of a city's tiles have been flooded, those tiles can be repaired in full. Submerged tiles however are never recoverable. Must be built in a city with one or more Coastal Lowland tiles. Will not be pillaged if the city is captured.

records.name: Food Market
records.summary: Can only be built once in a city, even if the city has multiple Neighborhoods.

records.name: Forbidden City
records.summary: +1 Wildcard policy slot Must be built on flat land adjacent to the City Center.

records.name: Foreign Ministry
records.summary: +3 Favor Diplomatic Favor. Leveraging City States costs half Gold Gold. City State units gain +4 Strength Combat Strength if you are the City State's Suzerain (including Leveraged Units). Awards +1 Governor Governor Title.

records.name: Foreign Trade
records.summary: Allows the creation of Traderoute Trade Routes.

records.name: Future Civic
records.summary: Can be completed multiple times, increasing your points towards the Score Victory. Also awards 1 Governor Governor title and 50 Favor Diplomatic Favor each time it is completed.

records.name: Future Tech
records.summary: Can be completed multiple times, increasing your points towards the Score Victory. Also grants all of your cities +5% Production Production towards city projects each time it is completed.

records.name: Gaesatae
records.summary: Gallic unique Ancient era unit that replaces the Warrior. This unit has increased cost and receives +10 Strength Combat Strength when fighting units with a higher base Combat Strength. +5 Strength Combat Strength vs. district defenses.

records.name: Galley
records.summary: Ancient era melee naval combat unit. Can only operate on Coastal waters until Cartography is researched.

records.name: Garde Impériale
records.summary: French unique Industrial era melee unit that replaces the Line Infantry. +10 Strength Combat Strength when fighting on your capital's continent. Greatgeneral Great General points for killing units.

records.name: Geothermal Plant
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Geothermal Plant. +1 Science Science. +2 Production Production. Provides 4 Power Power per turn. Must be built on a Geothermal Fissure.

records.name: Germany
records.summary: A flexible production civilization that can support dense district planning and powerful late-game cities.

records.name: Giant Death Robot
records.summary: Information Era Super-Unit. Able to move and fight in water. Resistant to Weapons of Mass Destruction. Combat abilities can be upgraded by researching future technologies.

records.name: Gilded Vault
records.summary: Unique to the Owls of Minerva, replaces the Bank. This Commercial Hub generates Culture Culture equal to its Gold Gold adjacency bonus. Having a Harbor in this city provides you with +1 Traderoute Trade Route capacity.

records.name: God King
records.summary: Useful when the early Faith helps secure a Pantheon sooner than passive generation would.

records.name: Golden Gate Bridge
records.summary: Land units can cross without needing to embark. Acts as Modern Road and creates Modern Roads (if not present) in land tiles on either end. City gains +3 Amenities Amenities. All tiles in this city +4 Appeal. +100% Tourism Tourism from improvements and National Parks in this city. Traderoute Trade Routes traveling through it can multiply the Gold Gold they get from districts at their destination. Must be built on a Coast tile. The bridge must run straight across the hex between two land tiles directly opposite one another. At least one water tile must be present on both the left and right sides of the bridge.

records.name: Golf Course
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Golf Course, unique to Scotland. +1 Amenities Amenity and +2 Gold Gold. +1 Culture Culture if adjacent to a City Center district and +1 Culture Culture if adjacent to an Entertainment Complex district. Additional Tourism Tourism and Housing Housing as you advance through the Civics and Technology Tree. Cannot be placed on Desert or Desert Hills. One per city. Tiles with Golf Courses cannot be swapped. +1 Appeal.

records.name: Government Plaza
records.summary: A district placed once in your empire to commemorate your government choices. Provides +8 Loyalty per turn to this city, and an increase of +1 to the adjacency bonuses being earned by any adjacent district. Awards +1 Governor Governor Title.

records.name: Grand Bazaar
records.summary: A building unique to the Ottomans. Accumulate 1 extra Strategic resource for every different type of Strategic resource this city has improved. Receive 1 Amenities Amenity for every Luxury resource this city has improved.

records.name: Grand Master's Chapel
records.summary: Grants the ability to buy land units with Faith Faith. Pillaging Improvements and Districts provides bonus Faith Faith. Awards +1 Governor Governor Title.

records.name: Great Admiral
records.summary: Each Greatadmiral Great Admiral has unique abilities, including a passive effect, and a Retire effect. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.

records.name: Great Artist
records.summary: Each Greatartist Great Artist generates a Greatwork Landscape Great Work of Art when activated. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.

records.name: Great Bath
records.summary: The Floodplains tiles along the river containing the Great Bath are now immune to Flood damage (though Food Food and Production Production bonuses from flooding drop by 50%). Floodplains tiles belonging to this city gain +1 Faith Faith for each time Flood damage is mitigated. Must be built on a Floodplains tile.

records.name: Great Engineer
records.summary: Each Greatengineer Great Engineer has unique abilities when activated. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.

records.name: Great General
records.summary: Each Greatgeneral Great General has unique abilities, including a passive effect, and a Retire effect. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.

records.name: Great Library
records.summary: Receive boosts to all Ancient and Classical era technologies. Receive a random tech boost after another player recruits a Greatscientist Great Scientist. Must be built on flat land adjacent to a Campus district with a Library.

records.name: Great Lighthouse
records.summary: +1 Movement Movement for all naval units Must be built on the Coast, and adjacent to land and a Harbor district with a Lighthouse.

records.name: Great Merchant
records.summary: Each Greatmerchant Great Merchant has unique abilities when activated. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.

records.name: Great Musician
records.summary: Each Greatmusician Great Musician generates a Greatwork Music Great Work of Music when activated. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.

records.name: Great Prophet
records.summary: Great Greatprophet Prophets can found a Religion when activated. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.

records.name: Great Scientist
records.summary: Each Greatscientist Great Scientist has unique abilities when activated. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.

records.name: Great Wall
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct the Great Wall, unique to China. +2 Gold Gold. Provides an increase to Strength Defense. Bonus to Gold Gold if adjacent to other segments. Additional Culture Culture and Tourism Tourism as you advance through the Technology Tree for adjacent segments. Must be built in a line along the borders of your empire. Can only be pillaged (never destroyed) by natural disasters.

records.name: Great Writer
records.summary: Each Greatwriter Great Writer generates a Greatwork Writing Great Work of Writing when activated. Visit the Great People panel to learn more, and track your progress.

records.name: Great Zimbabwe
records.summary: +1 Traderoute Trade Route capacity Your Traderoute Trade Routes from this city get +2 Gold Gold for every Bonus resource within 3 tiles of the city and in this city's territory. Must be built adjacent to a Commercial Hub district with a Market and adjacent to Resource Cattle Cattle.

records.name: Grove
records.summary: Grants +1 Food Food and +1 Faith Faith to adjacent unimproved Charming tiles. Increased to +2 Food Food, +2 Faith Faith, +2 Culture Culture for adjacent unimproved Breathtaking tiles.

records.name: Gunpowder
records.summary: Quarry improvements receive +1 Production Production. Unlocks a Governor Governor title for Suleiman (Kanuni).

records.name: Guru
records.summary: May use a charge to heal itself and all adjacent friendly religious units. May not initiate theological combat with units of other Religions (but can defend).

records.name: Hacienda
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Hacienda, unique to Gran Colombia. +2 Gold Gold, +1 Production Production, and +0.5 Housing Housing. +1 Food Food for every two adjacent Plantations (increased to every Plantation with Replaceable Parts). Plantations and Haciendas receive +1 Production Production for every two adjacent Haciendas (increased to every Hacienda with Rapid Deployment). Can only be built on Plains, Plains Hills, Grassland, and Grassland Hills.

records.name: Hagia Sophia
records.summary: Missionaries and Apostles can spread Religion 1 extra time. Must be built on flat land adjacent to a Holy Site district, and you must have founded a Religion.

records.name: Hangar
records.summary: +25% combat experience for air units trained in this city. +1 air unit slot in Aerodrome district.

records.name: Hanging Gardens
records.summary: All Hero units have 10% longer Lifespan Lifespans. Increases growth by 15% in all cities. Must be built next to a River.

records.name: Hansa
records.summary: Germany's specialized production district rewards deliberately clustered city and district layouts.

records.name: Harbor
records.summary: A district for naval activity in your city. Also removes the Movement Movement penalty for embarking and disembarking to and from this tile. Must be built on Coast or Lake Terrain adjacent to land. Cannot be built on Reef.

records.name: Heavy Chariot
records.summary: Hard-hitting, Ancient era heavy cavalry unit. Gains 1 bonus Movement Movement if it begins a turn on a flat tile with no Woods, Rainforest, or Hills.

records.name: Helicopter
records.summary: Fast-moving Atomic era light cavalry unit.

records.name: Hercules
records.summary: Demigod of superhuman strength, renowned for his famous Labors.

records.name: Hermitage
records.summary: Must be built along a River.

records.name: Hetairoi
records.summary: Macedonian unique heavy cavalry unit that replaces the Horseman. Additional +5 Strength Combat Strength when adjacent to a Great General. +5 Great General points when killing an enemy unit. Starts with 1 free Promotion.

records.name: Highlander
records.summary: Scottish unique Industrial Era unit that replaces the Ranger. Strong reconnaissance unit. +5 Strength Combat Strength bonus when fighting in Hill and Forest terrain.

records.name: Himiko
records.summary: Shaman-Queen of ancient Japan, renowned for her wisdom and mystical power.

records.name: Hippodrome
records.summary: A district unique to Byzantium. Replaces the Entertainment Complex district, provides +3 Amenities Amenities, and is cheaper to build. When the Hippodrome and buildings in this district are constructed, receive a Heavy Cavalry unit. Units granted from this district do not have a resource maintenance cost. Cannot be built in a city with a Water Park.

records.name: Hippolyta
records.summary: Warrior Queen of the Amazons, renowned for her leadership and martial skill.

records.name: Holy Site
records.summary: A district in your city for religious worship.

records.name: Hoplite
records.summary: Greek unique Ancient era anti-cavalry unit that replaces the Spearman. +10 Strength Combat Strength if there is at least one adjacent Hoplite unit.

records.name: Horseman
records.summary: Fast-moving Classical era light cavalry unit.

records.name: Huey Teocalli
records.summary: +1 Amenities Amenity from entertainment for each Lake tile within one tile of Huey Teocalli. +1 Food Food and +1 Production Production for each Lake tile in your empire. Must be built on a Lake tile adjacent to land.

records.name: Hul'che
records.summary: Mayan unique Ancient Era ranged unit that replaces the Archer. Strong ranged attack. +5 Strength Combat Strength when fighting a wounded opponent.

records.name: Hunahpu & Xbalanque
records.summary: Legendary athletes and heroes of the Maya, renowned for their power over death and the Underworld.

records.name: Huszár
records.summary: Hungarian unique Industrial era unit that replaces Cavalry. +3 Strength Combat Strength for every active Alliance.

records.name: Hwacha
records.summary: Korean unique Renaissance Era unit that replaces the Field Cannon. High Ranged Ranged Attack Strength. Cannot move and attack in the same turn.

records.name: Hydroelectric Dam
records.summary: Provides the city +6 Power Power from renewable water sources.

records.name: Hypaspist
records.summary: Macedonian unique melee unit that replaces the Swordsman. +5 Strength Combat Strength when besieging districts. 50% Additional Support Bonus.

records.name: Ice Hockey Rink
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct an Ice Hockey Rink, unique to Canada. +1 Amenities Amenity. +1 Culture Culture for each adjacent Tundra, Tundra Hills, Snow, and Snow Hills tile. Provides Tourism Tourism from Culture once Flight is unlocked. +2 Food Food and Production Production once the Professional Sports civic is unlocked. +4 Culture Culture if adjacent to a Stadium building. Can be built on Tundra, Tundra Hills, Snow, and Snow Hills. One per city. +2 Appeal.

records.name: Ideology
records.summary: Grants the ability to construct an additional Spy.

records.name: Ikanda
records.summary: A district unique to Zulu which replaces the Encampment. Provides +1 Housing Housing. Once the Civic or Technology prerequisite is met, Corps and Armies can be built outright. Buildings in the Ikanda receive +2 Gold Gold and +1 Science Science. Faster Corps and Army creation.

records.name: Immortal
records.summary: Persian unique melee unit that replaces the Swordsman. Melee class unit with a ranged attack, Range Range 2. Strong defense strength.

records.name: Impi
records.summary: Zulu unique Medieval Era unit that replaces the Pikeman. Increased Flanking bonus, low cost and low maintenance. Earns XP faster.

records.name: Industrial Zone
records.summary: Concentrates Production and enables cities to complete expensive projects faster.

records.name: Industrialization
records.summary: +1 Production Production to the Mine improvement.

records.name: Industry
records.summary: An industry dedicated to a specific Luxury Resource. Provides a unique benefit to its city, as well as +1 Greatmerchant Great Merchant point.

records.name: Inquisitor
records.summary: May reduce the presence of other Religions in their territory by 75%, and initiate theological combat with units of other Religions.

records.name: Intelligence Agency
records.summary: +1 Spy and Spy capacity. All Spy Operations have a higher chance of success. Awards +1 Governor Governor Title.

records.name: Iron
records.summary: Its location can reshape early settlement and military plans once Bronze Working reveals it.

records.name: Ironclad
records.summary: Powerful Industrial era armored melee naval unit.

records.name: Irrigation
records.summary: Allows clearing of Marsh, and harvesting of Resource Bananas Bananas.

records.name: Janissary
records.summary: Ottoman unique Renaissance Era unit that replaces the Musketman. Starts with a free promotion. Stronger and cheaper than the Musketman. To train a Janissary a city must have a population of at least 2. If a city is founded by the Ottomans and trains a Janissary it loses a population.

records.name: Jebel Barkal
records.summary: Awards 6 Resource Iron Iron per turn. Provides +4 Faith Faith to all your cities that are within 6 tiles. Must be built on Desert (Hills) terrain.

records.name: Jong
records.summary: Indonesian unique Medieval era naval unit that replaces the Frigate. Formation units all inherit escort's Movement Movement speed and +5 Strength Combat Strength when in a formation.

records.name: Kampung
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Kampung, unique to Indonesia. +1 Production Production and +1 Housing Housing. +1 Food Food for each adjacent Fishing Boat. Additional Production Production, Housing Housing, and Tourism Tourism as you advance through the Technology and Civics Tree. Must be placed on a Coast or Lake tile adjacent to a sea resource.

records.name: Keshig
records.summary: Mongolian unique Medieval Era Ranged Cavalry unit. Can escort moving civilian and support units at their higher Movement Movement speed.

records.name: Khevsur
records.summary: Georgian unique Medieval Era unit that replaces the Man-At-Arms. +7 Strength Combat Strength bonus when fighting in hill terrain. No Movement Movement penalty in hill terrain.

records.name: Kilwa Kisiwani
records.summary: +3 Envoy Envoys when built. When you are the Suzerain of a City-State this city receives a +15% boost to the Type bonuses provided by that City-State. If you are the Suzerain to 2 or more City-States of that type an additional +15% boost is given to all your cities. Must be built on a flat tile adjacent to Coast.

records.name: Knight
records.summary: Hard-hitting, Medieval era heavy cavalry unit.

records.name: Kotoku-in
records.summary: +20% Faith Faith in this city. Grants 4 Warrior Monks. Must be built adjacent to a Holy Site district with a Temple. Warrior Monks can only be received if player has founded a religion or if there is a majority religion for this player or city.

records.name: Kurgan
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Kurgan, unique to Scythia. +1 Faith Faith and +3 Gold Gold. +1 Faith Faith for each adjacent Pasture (becomes +2 after researching Stirrups). Provides Tourism Tourism from Faith Faith after researching Flight. Cannot be built on Hills.

records.name: Lavra
records.summary: A district unique to Russia for religious activity. Replaces the Holy Site district and cheaper to build. Your city border grows by one tile each time a Great Person is expended in this city. The Lavra provides +1 Greatwriter Great Writer point per turn with a Shrine, +1 Greatartist Great Artist point per turn with a Temple, and +1 Greatmusician Great Musician point per turn with a Worship building.

records.name: Legion
records.summary: Roman unique Classical era melee unit that replaces the Swordsman. Can build a Roman Fort.

records.name: Library
records.summary: An early, dependable way to turn a Campus into continuing Science and Great Scientist progress.

records.name: Lighthouse
records.summary: +25% combat experience for all naval units trained in this city. +1 Food Food on all Coast tiles for this city. +2 Housing Housing if this city is adjacent to coast. +1 Traderoute Trade Route capacity, if this city does not yet have a Market building.

records.name: Llanero
records.summary: Gran Colombian Industrial era unique unit that replaces the Cavalry. Low maintenance cost. +2 Strength Combat Strength for every adjacent Llanero. Fully heals when in range of a Comandante General that activates its retire ability.

records.name: Lumber Mill
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Lumber Mill. +2 Production Production. Can only be built on Woods. Once Mercantilism is unlocked it can also be built on Rainforest.

records.name: Machu Picchu
records.summary: Mountain tiles provide a standard adjacency bonus to Commercial Hub, Theater Square, and Industrial Zone districts in all cities. Must be built on a Mountain tile that does not contain a Volcano.

records.name: Madrasa
records.summary: A building unique to Arabia. Bonus Faith Faith equal to the adjacency bonus of the Campus district.

records.name: Mahabodhi Temple
records.summary: +2 Diplomatic Victory Points and grants 2 Apostles when built. Must be built on Woods adjacent to a Holy Site district with a Temple, and you must have founded a Religion.

records.name: Mahavihara
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Mahavihara. +2 Science Science and +1 Housing Housing. +1 Faith Faith for every adjacent Holy Site district and +1 Science Science for every adjacent Campus district. After researching Scientific Theory receive an additional +1 Science Science for every adjacent Campus. When a player constructs their first Mahavihara receive a random technology. Must be built on flat terrain not adjacent to another Mahavihara.

records.name: Malón Raider
records.summary: Mapuche unique Renaissance Era unit. +5 Strength Combat Strength bonus if within 4 hexes of friendly territory. Pillaging costs 1 Movement Movement.

records.name: Mamluk
records.summary: Arabian unique Medieval era unit that replaces the Knight. Heals at the end of every turn, even after moving or attacking.

records.name: Mandekalu Cavalry
records.summary: Mali unique Medieval Era unit that replaces the Knight. Trader units are immune to being plundered if they are within 4 tiles of a Mandekalu Cavalry and on a land tile. Combat victories provide Gold Gold equal to 100% of that unit's base Strength Combat Strength (on Standard Speed).

records.name: Marae
records.summary: A building unique to the Māori. +1 Culture Culture and Faith Faith to all of this city's tiles with a passable feature or natural wonder. After Flight is researched receive +1 Tourism Tourism to all of this city's tiles with a feature or natural wonder. Costs no maintenance. Has no Great Work slots.

records.name: Market
records.summary: +1 Traderoute Trade Route capacity, if this city does not yet have a Lighthouse building.

records.name: Maryannu Chariot Archer
records.summary: Egyptian unique Ancient era ranged unit. 4 Movement Movement when starting in open terrain.

records.name: Masonry
records.summary: Allows harvesting of Resource Stone Stone.

records.name: Mathematics
records.summary: +1 Movement Movement for all naval units.

records.name: Maui
records.summary: Demigod and hero of Polynesian myth, renowned for his feats and gifts to humanity.

records.name: Mausoleum at Halicarnassus
records.summary: +1 Science Science, +1 Faith Faith, and +1 Culture Culture on all Coast tiles for this city. Greatengineer Great Engineers have an additional charge. Must be built adjacent to a Harbor district.

records.name: Mbanza
records.summary: A district unique to Kongo that can only be constructed in Rainforest or Woods. Replaces the Neighborhood district but is available earlier and cheaper to build. Provides +5 Housing Housing , +2 Food Food, and +4 Gold Gold, regardless of Appeal.

records.name: Medic
records.summary: Industrial era support unit. Can heal adjacent units.

records.name: Medieval Walls
records.summary: Increases the strength of your outer defenses. Provides 2 Tourism Tourism after advancing to the Conservation Civic. This city is not affected by Battering Rams.

records.name: Meenakshi Temple
records.summary: Grants 2 Gurus. Gurus are 30% cheaper to purchase. Religious units adjacent to Gurus receive +5 Religion Religious Strength in Theological Combat and +1 Movement Movement. Must be built adjacent to a Holy Site and you must have founded a Religion.

records.name: Mekewap
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Mekewap, unique to Cree. Provides +1 Production Production and +1 Housing Housing. +1 Gold Gold if adjacent to a Luxury resource. For every 2 adjacent Bonus Resources +1 Food Food. Additional Production Production, Gold Gold, Food Food, and Housing Housing as you advance through the Civics and Technology Tree. Must be placed adjacent to a Bonus or Luxury resource. Cannot be built adjacent to another Mekewap.

records.name: Mercantilism
records.summary: Camp improvements receive +1 Production Production and +1 Food Food. Lumber Mills can be built on Rainforest. Grants the ability to see the amounts of all of the resources in the world.

records.name: Military Academy
records.summary: +25% combat experience for all land units trained in this city. Strategic Resource Stockpiles increased +10 (on Standard Speed). Allows Corps and Armies to be trained directly. Corps and Army training costs reduced 25%.

records.name: Military Engineer
records.summary: Medieval era support unit. Requires an Armory to produce. Can construct Roads, Railroads, Forts, Airstrips, Missile Silos, and Mountain Tunnel improvements. One of their build charges can also be used to complete 20% of a Canal, Dam or Aqueduct district or a Flood Barrier building.

records.name: Military Tradition
records.summary: Grants flanking and support combat bonuses to all combat units.

records.name: Minas Geraes
records.summary: Brazilian unique Industrial era unit that replaces the Battleship. Stronger than the Battleship. Unlocked by Nationalism.

records.name: Mine
records.summary: A core Production improvement whose value grows through later technologies and policies.

records.name: Mining
records.summary: A common early choice when nearby resources need Mines or when production improvements are important.

records.name: Missile Cruiser
records.summary: Strongest ranged naval unit, available in the Information era.

records.name: Missile Silo
records.summary: Unlocks the Military Engineer ability to construct a Missile Silo. Acts as a launch site for Nuclear and Thermonuclear Devices.

records.name: Mission
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Mission, unique to Spain. +2 Faith Faith. +2 Faith Faith, +1 Production Production, and +1 Food Food if on a different continent than your Capital Capital. +1 Science Science for every adjacent Campus and Holy Site district. Additional Science Science once Cultural Heritage is discovered. +2 Loyalty per turn for cities with a Mission improvement adjacent to the City Center and not on your original Capital Capital's continent.

records.name: Missionary
records.summary: May convert Citizen Citizens to their Religion. May not initiate theological combat with units of other Religions (but can defend).

records.name: Moai
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Moai. +1 Culture Culture. +1 Culture Culture for every 2 adjacent Moai. +2 Culture Culture if on or adjacent to a Volcanic Soil tile. +1 Culture Culture if adjacent to a Coast or Lake tile . Additional Culture Culture and Tourism Tourism as you advance through the Civics and Technology Tree. Can be built on Plains, Plains Hills, Grassland, Grassland Hills, or Volcanic Soil. Cannot be placed adjacent to a Woods or Rainforest tile.

records.name: Mobile SAM
records.summary: Information era anti-air support unit. Provides cover from air and nuclear attacks up to 1 hex away from the weapon.

records.name: Mobilization
records.summary: Allows forming three identical units into an Army or Armada. Allows one new Casus Belli that can be used to justify wars: War of Territorial Expansion.

records.name: Modern Armor
records.summary: Information era heavy cavalry unit that is fast and strong.

records.name: Modern AT
records.summary: Information era counter to cavalry class units.

records.name: Modernized Trap
records.summary: An unworkable later Improvement that deals significant damage to, and depletes the movement of, hostile units passing directly through it. Unlocked with Ballistics and built using a Charge from a Military Engineer. Does not prevent unit movement through this space.

records.name: Mont St. Michel
records.summary: All Apostles you create gain the Martyr ability in addition to a second ability you chose normally. Must be built on Floodplains or Marsh.

records.name: Monument
records.summary: Provides +1 Loyalty per turn in this city. If the city already has maximum Loyalty, also provides an additional +1 Culture Culture.

records.name: Mosque
records.summary: Missionary and Apostles created here have +1 spread.

records.name: Mountain Tunnel
records.summary: Unlocks the Military Engineer ability to construct a Mountain Tunnel. Acts as a movement portal on a mountain range, allowing units to move into it and exit from another portal at the cost of 2 Movement Movement. Traderoute Trade Routes traveling through it can multiply the Gold Gold they get from districts at their destination. Can only be built on an adjacent Mountain tile. Cannot be pillaged or removed.

records.name: Mountie
records.summary: Canadian unique Modern era unit. Can create 2 National Parks. +5 Strength Combat Strength when fighting within 2 tiles of a National Park. Additional +5 Strength Combat Strength when fighting within 2 tiles of a National Park you own.

records.name: Mulan
records.summary: Devoted and skilled warrior, renowned for her devotion and loyalty.

records.name: National History Museum
records.summary: Provides 4 slots for any Great Work. Awards +1 Governor Governor Title.

records.name: Nationalism
records.summary: Grants the ability to construct an additional Spy. Allows forming two identical units into a Corps or Fleet. Allows one new Casus Belli that can be used to justify wars: Colonial War.

records.name: Naturalist
records.summary: A late-game civilian who can create a single National Park to attract Tourism Tourists. Must be purchased with Faith Faith.

records.name: Nau
records.summary: Portuguese unique naval melee unit that replaces the Caravel. Starts with 1 free Promotion and is less maintenance. Has two charges to build Feitorias.

records.name: Navigation School
records.summary: A building unique to Portugal. +25% Production Production towards naval units in this city. +1 Science Science for every two coast or lake tiles in this city. +1 Greatadmiral Great Admiral and +1 Greatscientist Great Scientist point per turn.

records.name: Nazca Line
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Nazca Line. +1 Faith Faith to adjacent tiles. +1 Faith Faith to adjacent tiles with a resource. +1 Food Food to adjacent Desert and Desert Hill tiles after discovering Civil Service. +1 Production Production to adjacent flat tiles after researching Mass Production. +1 Appeal. Can only be built on flat Desert. This tile cannot be worked .

records.name: Neighborhood
records.summary: A district in your city that provides housing based on the Appeal of the tile: Breathtaking: +6 Housing Housing. Charming: +5 Housing Housing. Average: +4 Housing Housing. Uninviting: +3 Housing Housing. Disgusting: +2 Housing Housing.

records.name: Ngao Mbeba
records.summary: Kongo unique Classical era unit that replaces the Swordsman. +10 Strength Combat Strength when defending against ranged attacks. Can move and see through Woods and Rainforest.

records.name: Nihang
records.summary: Lahore City-State unique unit with a unique Promotion tree. Purchasable with Faith Faith. Strength Combat Strength is increased when Barracks, Armory, and Military Academy buildings are first constructed.

records.name: Nubian Pyramid
records.summary: Improvement that unlocks with Masonry and must be built on Desert, Desert Hills or Floodplains. +2 Faith Faith and +2 Food Food. Receives additional yields from adjacent districts. +1 Food Food if adjacent to a city center. For all other districts that award adjacency bonuses: +1 of the appropriate yield if that district is adjacent.

records.name: Nuclear Power Plant
records.summary: Automatically converts any amount of Resource Uranium Uranium into Power Power for cities within 6 tiles that need it each turn, at the rate of: Bullet1 Resource Uranium Uranium Powerright 16 Power Power BulletMiniscule CO2 into the atmosphere Once built, as a Nuclear Power Plant ages, there is an increased chance for a Nuclear Accident to occur. Its Production Production and Science Science bonus is extended to all City Centers within 6 tiles that do not already have a bonus from a Power Plant building.

records.name: Nuclear Submarine
records.summary: Highly advanced Information era ranged raiding naval unit that can be armed with nuclear weapons. Can only be seen by other Naval Raiders unless adjacent to it. Reveals Naval Raiders within sight range.

records.name: Observation Balloon
records.summary: Modern era support unit. Grants +1 Range Range to Siege class units within 1 hex.

records.name: Observatory
records.summary: A district unique to the Maya for scientific endeavors. Replaces the Campus district and cheaper to build. +2 Science Science bonus for adjacent Plantations. +1 Science Science bonus for every two adjacent Farm or district tiles.

records.name: Offshore Oil Rig
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct an Offshore Oil Rig. -1 Appeal. Can only be built on Coast or Lake tiles with Resource Oil Oil.

records.name: Offshore Wind Farm
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct an Offshore Wind Farm. +2 Production Production. Provides 2 Power Power per turn. Must be built on Coast or Lake terrain.

records.name: Oil Power Plant
records.summary: Automatically converts any amount of Resource Oil Oil into Power Power for cities within 6 tiles that need it each turn, at the rate of: Bullet1 Resource Oil Oil Powerright 4 Power Power BulletModerate CO2 into the atmosphere Its Production Production bonus is extended to all City Centers within 6 tiles that do not already have a bonus from a Power Plant building.

records.name: Oil Well
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct an Oil Well. -1 Appeal. Can only be built on land tiles withResource Oil Oil.

records.name: Okihtcitaw
records.summary: Cree unique Ancient era unit that replaces the Scout. Strong reconnaissance unit. Starts with 1 free promotion.

records.name: Old God Obelisk
records.summary: Unique to the Voidsingers, replaces the Monument. Contains 1 Great Work slot that can hold any type of Great Work. Provides +1 Loyalty per turn in this city. If the city already has maximum Loyalty, also provides an additional +1 Culture Culture.

records.name: Oligarchy
records.summary: Supports an early land-war plan or a period of heightened military risk.

records.name: Open-Air Museum
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct an Open-Air Museum, unique to Sweden. Provides +2 Loyalty per turn in this city. +2 Culture Culture and +2 Tourism Tourism for each type of terrain (Snow, Tundra, Desert, Plains or Grassland) in which at least one Swedish city is founded. One per city. Tiles with Open-Air Museums cannot be swapped.

records.name: Oppidum
records.summary: A district unique to Gaul that is cheaper and available earlier than the district it replaces, the Industrial Zone. The Oppidum district is defensible with a ranged attack. When the first Oppidum is constructed the Apprenticeship technology is unlocked. +2 Production Production adjacency bonus from Quarries and strategic resources.

records.name: Oracle
records.summary: Recalling Heroes costs 15% less Faith Faith, and Patronage of Great People costs 25% less Faith Faith. Districts in this city provide +2 Greatperson Great Person points of their type (for example, Greatwriter Great Writer points from the Theater Square district). Must be built on Hills.

records.name: Ordu
records.summary: A building unique to Mongolia. Grants an ability that gives +1 Movement Movement to Heavy and Light Cavalry trained in this city. +25% combat experience for all cavalry and siege class units trained in this city. May not be built in an Encampment district that already has a Barracks.

records.name: Oromo Cavalry
records.summary: Ethiopian unique Medieval era light cavalry unit. Stronger and greater sight than the Courser that it replaces. Receives no Movement Movement penalty from moving in Hills.

records.name: Országház
records.summary: +100% Favor Diplomatic Favor per turn from starting a turn as Suzerain of a City-State. Must be built on a River.

records.name: Outback Station
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct an Outback Station, unique to Australia. +1 Food Food and +1 Production Production. +1 Food Food for each adjacent Pasture. Additional Food Food and Production Production as you advance through the Technology and Civic Tree for adjacent Outback Stations and Pastures. Can only be built in Desert, Desert Hills, Grassland, and Plains tiles.

records.name: Oxford University
records.summary: +20% Science Science in this city, and awards 2 randomly-chosen free technologies when completed. Must be built on Grassland or Plains adjacent to a Campus district with a University.

records.name: Oya
records.summary: Orisha of winds, storms, and lightning, renowned for her extreme power.

records.name: P-51 Mustang
records.summary: American unique Atomic era air unit that replaces the Fighter. Gains +5 Strength Combat Strength against fighter aircraft, has +2 flight range, and gains +50% experience.

records.name: Pairidaeza
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Pairidaeza, unique to Persia. +1 Culture Culture and +2 Gold Gold. +1 Appeal. +1 Culture Culture for each adjacent Holy Site and Theater Square. +1 Gold Gold for each adjacent Commercial Hub and City Center. Additional Culture Culture and Tourism Tourism as you advance through the Technology and Civics Tree. Cannot be built on Snow, Tundra, Snow Hills, or Tundra Hills or adjacent to another Pairidaeza.

records.name: Palgum
records.summary: A building unique to Babylon. +1 Housing Housing and +2 Production Production. Freshwater tiles receive +1 Food Food. City must be adjacent to a River.

records.name: Panama Canal
records.summary: Upon completion 1 or 2 adjacent Canal districts are automatically constructed. The Canal wonder tile can now be crossed by naval units. Traderoute Trade Routes traveling through it can multiply the Gold Gold they get from districts at their destination. Must be built on a flat land tile where there are two adjacent tiles directly across the build tile from one another that meet the following criteria: one adjacent tile must be able to legally hold a Canal district connecting into the Panama Canal construction tile; the other must be either a city, a water tile, or be another tile that can hold a connecting Canal.

records.name: Pasture
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct Pastures. +1 Production Production. Can only be built on valid resources. If built on Strategic resources, the city will gain use of that resource.

records.name: Petra
records.summary: +2 Food Food, +2 Gold Gold, and +1 Production Production on all Desert tiles for this city (non-Floodplains). Must be built on Desert or Desert Floodplains without Hills.

records.name: Plantation
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct Plantations. +2 Gold Gold. Can only be built on valid resources. If built on Luxury resources, the city will gain use of that resource.

records.name: Polder
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Polder, unique to Netherlands. +1 Food Food, +1 Production Production, and +0.5 Housing Housing. +1 Food Food if adjacent to a Polder improvement. Additional Production Production, Gold Gold, and Food Food as you advance through the Civics and Technology Tree. Must be placed on a Coast or Lake tile adjacent to 3 or more passable land tiles. Increases Movement Movement Cost of tile to 3.

records.name: Political Philosophy
records.summary: The first government choice is a major flexibility spike because it expands policy capacity and adds a distinct empire bonus.

records.name: Potala Palace
records.summary: +1 Diplomatic policy slot. +1 Diplomatic Victory point. Must be built on a Hill adjacent to a Mountain.

records.name: Pottery
records.summary: Allows harvesting of Bonus resources improved by Farms.

records.name: Prasat
records.summary: +6 Faith Faith. A building unique to Khmer. Replaces the Temple. Required to purchase Apostles and Inquisitors with Faith Faith. +0.5 Culture Culture for every Citizen population in this city. Once Flight is researched receive +10 Tourism Tourism if the city Citizen population is 10 or higher and +20 Tourism Tourism if the city Citizen population is 20 or higher.

records.name: Predictive Systems
records.summary: +1 Production Production to Quarry, Oil Well, and Oil Rig improvements.

records.name: Preserve
records.summary: Grants up to 3 Housing Housing based on Appeal. Culture bombs adjacent neutral tiles, and increases their Appeal by 1.

records.name: Printing
records.summary: Provides one more level of diplomatic visibility on all other civilizations. All Tourism Tourism yields from Greatwork Writing Great Works of Writing are doubled.

records.name: Privateer
records.summary: Renaissance era ranged naval unit with the ability to coastal raid.Can only be seen by other Naval Raiders unless adjacent to it. Reveals Naval Raiders within sight range.

records.name: Pyramids
records.summary: Grants a free Builder. All Builders can build 1 extra improvement. Must be built on Desert (including Desert Floodplains) without Hills.

records.name: Pítati Archer
records.summary: Nubian unique Ancient era unit that replaces the Archer. Stronger than the Archer with extra Movement Movement. Upgrades to Crossbowman.

records.name: Qhapaq Ñan

Acts as a movement portal on a mountain range, allowing units to move into it and exit from another portal at the cost of 2 Movement Movement. Traderoute Trade Routes traveling through it can multiply the Gold Gold they get from districts at their destination. Can only be built on an adjacent Mountain tile. Cannot be pillaged or removed.

records.name: Quadrireme
records.summary: Classical era ranged naval unit. Can only operate on Coastal waters until Cartography is researched.

records.name: Quarry
records.summary: Provides sustained Production and can support Industrial Zone planning.

records.name: Queen's Bibliotheque
records.summary: A building unique to Sweden. This building provides 2 slots of Greatwork Writing Writing, Greatwork Music Music, and any type of Greatwork Landscape Art. Awards +1 Governor Governor Title.

records.name: Questing Knight
records.summary: Heavy Cavalry. One of Arthur's chosen Knights and strengthened by his charge.

records.name: Rapid Deployment
records.summary: Allows for the transport of land units between Aerodrome districts that contain Airports.

records.name: Redcoat
records.summary: English unique Industrial era unit when Victoria is their leader that replaces the Line Infantry. +10 Strength Combat Strength when fighting on a continent other than that of your capital's. No disembark cost.

records.name: Reinforced Barricade
records.summary: An unworkable later Improvement that deals moderate damage to, and exerts zone of control on, hostile units passing through or adjacent to it. Unlocked with Rifling and built using a Charge from a Military Engineer. Does not prevent unit movement through this space.

records.name: Renaissance Walls
records.summary: Raises the strength of your outer defenses to the highest possible level. Provides 3 Tourism Tourism after advancing to the Conservation Civic. This city is not affected by Siege Towers or Battering Rams.

records.name: Replaceable Parts
records.summary: Upgrades Farm improvements to Mechanized Agriculture. +1 Food Food Adjacency bonus for every Farm improvement they are adjacent to. Pasture improvements receive +1 Production Production.

records.name: Rock Band
records.summary: Can perform a rock concert at a valid venue, including at Wonders, at a District with one of the required buildings, or at a special target allowed by one of the band's promotions. Their Album Sales stat is the expected Tourism Tourism strength at their next concert. After performing concerts their Album Sales and Rock Band Level may increase. Must be purchased with Faith Faith. Cannot perform on the same tile twice.

records.name: Rock-Hewn Church
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Rock-Hewn Church, unique to Ethiopia. +1 Faith Faith. +1 Faith Faith for every adjacent Mountain and Hills tile. Provides Tourism Tourism from Faith Faith, after researching Flight. +1 Appeal. Can only be pillaged (never destroyed) by natural disasters. Can only be built on Hills or Volcanic Soil not adjacent to another Rock-Hewn Church.

records.name: Rocket Artillery
records.summary: Information era siege unit, ideal for attacking cities. Cannot move and attack on the same turn unless they've earned the Expert Crew promotion.

records.name: Rocketry
records.summary: +1 Production Production from the Quarry improvement.

records.name: Rome
records.summary: A dependable expansion civilization with strong early infrastructure and connected cities.

records.name: Rough Rider
records.summary: American unique Industrial era unit when Teddy Roosevelt is their leader that replaces the Cuirassiers. Culture Culture is earned from kills on their Capital Capital's continent. +10 Strength Combat Strength when fighting on Hills. Lower maintenance cost.

records.name: Royal Navy Dockyard
records.summary: A district unique to England for naval activity in your city. Replaces the Harbor district. Also removes the Movement Movement penalty for embarking and disembarking to and from this tile. Must be built on Coast or Lake Terrain adjacent to land. +1 Movement Movement for all naval units built in Dockyard +2 Gold Gold and +4 Loyalty per turn when built on a foreign continent. Cannot be built on Reef

records.name: Royal Society
records.summary: Builders gain the ability to use all of their charges to provide bonus Production Production to a District Project. Once per city per turn. Awards +1 Governor Governor Title.

records.name: Ruhr Valley
records.summary: +20% Production Production in this city, and +1 Production Production for each Mine and Quarry in this city. Must be built along a River adjacent to an Industrial Zone district with a Factory.

records.name: Sabum Kibittum
records.summary: Babylonian unique Ancient era melee unit. +17 Strength Combat Strength against Heavy and Light Cavalry promotion class units. This unit has 3 Movement Movement and sight.

records.name: Saka Horse Archer
records.summary: Scythian unique Classical era unit. Ranged unit with 4 Movement Movement with a Range Range of 1.

records.name: Samurai
records.summary: Japanese unique Medieval era melee unit that replaces the Man-At-Arms. Does not suffer combat penalties when damaged.

records.name: Sanctuary
records.summary: Grants +1 Science Science and +1 Gold Gold to adjacent unimproved Charming tiles. Increased to +2 Science Science, +2 Gold Gold, +2 Production Production for adjacent unimproved Breathtaking tiles.

records.name: Scientific Theory
records.summary: +1 Food Food from the Plantation improvement.

records.name: Sea Dog
records.summary: English unique Renaissance era naval unit that replaces the Privateer. Has a chance to capture defeated enemy ships. Can only be seen by other Naval Raiders unless adjacent to it. Reveals Naval Raiders within sight range.

records.name: Seaport
records.summary: +25% combat experience for all naval units trained in this city. Allows Fleets and Armadas to be trained directly. Fleet and Armada training costs reduced 25%. +2 Gold Gold on all Coast tiles for this city.

records.name: Seaside Resort
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct Seaside Resorts. Provides Tourism Tourism equal to the tile's Appeal. Can only be built on Coastal Desert, Coastal Plains, or Coastal Grassland tiles. Minimum Appeal of Breathtaking.

records.name: Seastead
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Seastead. +2 Food Food. +1 Production Production for each adjacent Fishing Boats. Fishing Boats receive +1 Production Production for each adjacent Seastead. +1 Culture Culture and Tourism Tourism for every adjacent Reef. +2 Housing Housing. Must be built on Coast, Lake or Ocean terrain. Cannot be placed adjacent to another Seastead.

records.name: Seowon
records.summary: A district unique to Korea for scientific endeavors. Replaces the Campus district. +4 Science Science. -1 Science Science for every adjacent district tile. Must be built on Hills.

records.name: Settler
records.summary: May create new cities. Reduces city's Citizen Population by 1 when completed.

records.name: Shipbuilding
records.summary: Allows all land units to embark.

records.name: Shipyard
records.summary: +25% combat experience for all naval units trained in this city. Bonus Production Production equal to the adjacency bonus of the Harbor district. +1 Production Production on all unimproved Coast and Lake tiles for this city.

records.name: Shopping Mall
records.summary: +4 Tourism Tourism. Can only be built once in a city, even if the city has multiple Neighborhoods.

records.name: Shrine
records.summary: Hero units claimed or recalled in this City have 10% longer Lifespan Lifespans. Allows the purchasing of Missionaries. Missionaries can only be purchased with Faith Faith.

records.name: Siege Tower
records.summary: Medieval era support unit. When adjacent to a city, attacking melee and anti-cavalry units ignore Walls and immediately assault the city. Does not affect cities with Renaissance Walls. Ineffective against Urban Defenses.

records.name: Sinbad
records.summary: Naval Hero. Adventurer and fortune-hunter, renowned for his strange and marvelous travels.

records.name: Ski Resort
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Ski Resort. Provides +4 Tourism Tourism. Provides an Amenities Amenity. Can only be built on a Mountain. Cannot be built adjacent to another Ski Resort. Cannot be pillaged, worked or removed.

records.name: Slinger
records.summary: Weak Ancient era ranged unit. Better on attack than defense.

records.name: Smart Materials
records.summary: Unlocks Giant Death Robot upgrade: Reinforced Armor Plating +10 Strength Combat Strength when defending against land and naval units.

records.name: Solar Farm
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Solar Farm. +1 Gold Gold. +1 Production Production. Provides 2 Power Power per turn. Must be built on flat terrain. Cannot be built on Snow.

records.name: Soothsayer
records.summary: An Apocalypse-mode-specific support unit. Can use the Cause Disaster action to begin a random disaster in the hexes near the unit. Doing so destroys the Soothsayer if it has no more charges.

records.name: Spaceport
records.summary: A district that is required to construct the Science Victory projects. This includes {LOC_PROJECT_LAUNCH_EARTH_SATELLITE_NAME}, {LOC_PROJECT_LAUNCH_MOON_LANDING_NAME}, {LOC_PROJECT_LAUNCH_MARS_BASE_NAME}, and {LOC_PROJECT_LAUNCH_EXOPLANET_EXPEDITION_NAME}. Cannot be built on Hills.

records.name: Spec Ops
records.summary: Atomic Era reconnaissance unit. Paradrop ability allows movement from friendly tile to location 7 tiles away (12 if starting from Aerodrome or Airstrip). Can attack support units directly without having to eliminate the combat unit first.

records.name: Sphinx
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Sphinx, unique to Egypt. +1 Faith Faith and +1 Culture Culture. +2 Appeal. +2 Faith Faith if next to a wonder. +1 Culture Culture if built on Floodplains. Additional Culture Culture once Natural History is discovered. Provides Tourism Tourism after researching Flight. Cannot be built next to another Sphinx. Cannot be built on Snow or Snow Hills.

records.name: Spy
records.summary: Performs secret missions in foreign cities and protects your cities from enemy Spies.

records.summary: +100% Tourism Religious Tourism from this city. +1 Food Food, +1 Production Production, and +1 Culture Culture on all Tundra tiles for this city. Must be built adjacent to a City Center.

records.name: Stable
records.summary: +25% combat experience for all cavalry and siege class units trained in this city. Strategic Resource Stockpiles increased +10 (on Standard Speed). May not be built in an Encampment district that already has a Barracks.

records.name: Stadium
records.summary: Bonus Amenities Amenities extend to each city center within 6 tiles.
