records.name: Statue of Liberty
records.summary: Grants 2 Settlers. All your cities within 6 tiles are always 100% Loyal. Must be built on the Coast, adjacent to land and a Harbor district.

records.name: Statue of Zeus
records.summary: Grants 3 Archers, 3 Spearmen, and a Battering Ram. +50% Production Production towards anti-cavalry units. Must be built on flat land adjacent to an Encampment district with a Barracks.

records.name: Stave Church
records.summary: A building unique to Norway. Required to purchase Apostles and Inquisitors with Faith Faith. Holy Site districts get an additional standard adjacency bonus from Woods. +1 Production Production to each coastal resource tile in this city. Recalling Heroes in this city costs 15% less Faith Faith.

records.name: Steel
records.summary: +1 Production Production from the Lumber Mill improvement. Unlocks Urban Defenses, giving all of your cities an automatic 400 Fortification Strength and the ability to perform a ranged attack. All previous wall improvements become obsolete and siege support units are no longer effective.

records.name: Stepwell
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Stepwell, unique to India. +1 Food Food and +1 Housing Housing. +1 Faith Faith if adjacent to a Holy Site district. +1 Food Food if adjacent to a Farm. Additional Housing Housing, Faith Faith, and Food Food as you advance through the Technology and Civics Tree. Prevents Food Food loss during Drought. Cannot be built on Hills or adjacent to another Stepwell.

records.name: Stone
records.summary: A production-oriented tile that can be improved for steady value or harvested to accelerate a timely build.

records.name: Stonehenge
records.summary: Grants a free Greatprophet Great Prophet. Greatprophet Great Prophets may found a Religion on Stonehenge instead of a Holy Site. Must be adjacent to Resource Stone Stone and on flat land.

records.name: Street Carnival
records.summary: A district unique to Brazil. Replaces the Entertainment Complex district, and provides +2 Amenities Amenities. Also unlocks the Carnival project, which grants an additional +1 Amenities Amenity when underway and a variety of Greatperson Great People points once completed. Cannot be built in a city with a Copacabana.

records.name: Submarine
records.summary: Modern era ranged raiding naval unit. Can only be seen by other Naval Raiders unless adjacent to it. Reveals Naval Raiders within sight range.

records.name: Suguba
records.summary: A district unique to Mali specializing in finance and trade that replaces the Commercial Hub. Units, Buildings, and Districts are 20% cheaper to purchase with Gold Gold and Faith Faith in this City. +2 Gold Gold bonus for each adjacent Holy Site. +2 Gold Gold bonus from a tile containing a River edge. +1 Gold Gold bonus for every two adjacent district tiles.

records.name: Sukiennice
records.summary: A building unique to Poland. International Traderoute Trade Routes from this city gain +2 Production Production; domestic Traderoute Trade Routes gain +4 Gold Gold. +1 Traderoute Trade Route capacity, if this city does not yet have a Lighthouse building.

records.name: Sun Wukong
records.summary: The Monkey King, hero of ancient China, renowned for his cunning and immortality.

records.name: Supply Convoy
records.summary: Modern era support unit. Increases healing for adjacent units. Gives units 1 bonus Movement Movement if move is started adjacent to the Convoy.

records.name: Sydney Opera House
records.summary: Must be built on the Coast, adjacent to land and a Harbor district.

records.name: Tagma
records.summary: Basil II's unique Medieval era unit that replaces the Knight. Land units within 1 tile of the Tagma receive +4 Strength Combat Strength or Religion Religious Strength.

records.name: Taj Mahal
records.summary: +1 Era Score from Historic Moment earned after this wonder is complete if that Moment is usually worth 2 or more Era Score. Must be built next to a River.

records.name: Tank
records.summary: Fast-moving Modern era heavy cavalry unit that ignores zone of control.

records.name: Temple
records.summary: Recalling Heroes in this city costs 15% less Faith Faith. Allows the purchasing of Apostles, Gurus, Inquisitors, and with the proper belief, Warrior Monks. These units can only be purchased with Faith Faith.

records.name: Temple of Artemis
records.summary: Each Camp, Pasture, and Plantation improvement within 4 tiles of this wonder provides +1 Amenities Amenity. Must be placed adjacent to a Camp improvement.

records.name: Terrace Farm
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Terrace Farm, unique to the Inca. +1 Food Food. Provides +1 Housing Housing. +1 Food Food for each adjacent Mountain Tile. Gain +2 Production Production for each adjacent Aqueduct district. Receive +1 Production Production if adjacent to Fresh Water and not an Aqueduct district. Additional Food Food as you advance through the Civics and Technology Tree for adjacency with other Terrace Farms. Can be placed on Grassland Hills, Plains Hills, and Desert Hills.

records.name: Terracotta Army
records.summary: All current units gain a promotion level. All Archaeologists from the owner may enter foreign lands without Open Borders. Must be built on flat Grassland or Plains adjacent to an Encampment district with a Barracks or Stable.

records.name: The Enlightenment
records.summary: Religious Tourism Tourism effects are halved versus your civilization.

records.name: Theater Square
records.summary: A district in your city for cultural sites.

records.name: Thermal Bath
records.summary: A building unique to Hungary. +2 Amenities Amenities and +2 Production Production extends to each city center within 6 tiles. These bonuses apply once to a city, and multiple copies of this building within 6 tiles of a city center do not provide additional bonuses. This city receives +3 Tourism Tourism and +2 additional Amenities Amenities if there is at least one Geothermal Fissure in this city's borders.

records.name: Thành
records.summary: A district unique to Vietnam which replaces the Encampment. +2 Culture Culture for each adjacent district. After Flight is researched receive Tourism Tourism equal to the Culture Culture output. This district does not require population, is cheaper to build, cannot be built adjacent to the city center, does not provide Greatperson Great People points, and is not a specialty district.

records.name: Tlachtli
records.summary: A building unique to the Aztecs. Provides 2 Amenities Amenities, +2 Culture Culture, +2 Faith Faith, and a Greatgeneral Great General Point. Provides +1 Tourism Tourism after advancing to the Conservation Civic.

records.name: Toa
records.summary: Māori unique Classical era melee unit. Adjacent enemy units receive -5 Strength Combat Strength. Can build the unique Pā improvement.

records.name: Torre de Belém
records.summary: International Traderoute Trade Routes from this city receive +2 Gold Gold for every Luxury Resource at the destination. When the Torre de Belém is constructed, cities not on your home continent receive the lowest Production Production cost city center building they can currently construct. Must be built on a Coast tile that is adjacent to a Harbor district.

records.name: Trader
records.summary: May make and maintain a single Traderoute Trade Route. Automatically creates Roads as it travels.

records.name: Trading Dome
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Trading Dome. +2 Gold Gold. +1 Gold Gold for every adjacent Luxury resource. Your outgoing international Traderoute Trade Routes grant +1 Gold Gold per Trading Dome at the origin. Cannot be built next to another Trading Dome.

records.name: Trajan
records.summary: Makes newly founded cities useful sooner and supports rapid expansion.

records.name: Trap
records.summary: An unworkable early Improvement that deals moderate damage to, and depletes the movement of, hostile units passing directly through it. Unlocked with Construction and built using a Builder Charge. Does not prevent unit movement through this space.

records.name: Trebuchet
records.summary: Medieval era siege unit, ideal for attacking cities. Cannot move and attack on the same turn unless they've earned the Expert Crew promotion.

records.name: Tsikhe
records.summary: A building unique to Georgia. Lower Production Production cost and higher outer defenses than Renaissance Walls. Provides +3 Tourism Tourism after advancing to the Conservation Civic. Provides +4 Faith Faith. When in a Golden Age the Tourism Tourism and Faith Faith are +100%.

records.name: U-Boat
records.summary: German unique Modern era naval unit that replaces the Submarine. Cheaper to produce, +1 Sight, and +10 Strength Combat Strength when fighting on Ocean tiles. Able to reveal other stealthed units.

records.name: University
records.summary: A mid-game Science investment best in cities whose Campus and population can justify the cost.

records.name: University of Sankore
records.summary: Other Civilizations' Traderoute Trade Routes to this city provide +1 Science Science and +1 Gold Gold for them. +2 Science Science for every Traderoute Trade Route to this city. Domestic Traderoute Trade Routes give an additional +1 Faith Faith to this city. Must be built on the Desert or Desert Hills, and adjacent to a Campus district with a University.

records.name: Uranium
records.summary: A late-game strategic resource worth securing before advanced units and infrastructure make demand urgent.

records.name: Urban Planning
records.summary: A broadly useful opening policy when your immediate needs are not more specialized.

records.name: Vampire
records.summary: Combat unit unique to the Sanguine Pact. Has base Strength Combat Strength equal to the strongest unit your cities have produced. Gains permanent Strength Combat Strength when units die in adjacent tiles. Strength from Barbarian deaths is capped at +10. When killed, retreats with 1 HP to the Capital Capital or nearest Vampire Castle. Heals an additional 50 HP from pillaging enemy tiles, but receives reduced passive healing.

records.name: Varu
records.summary: Indian unique Classical era heavy cavalry unit. Adjacent enemy units receive -5 Strength Combat Strength.

records.name: Venetian Arsenal
records.summary: Receive a second naval unit each time you train a naval unit. Must be built on a Coast tile that is adjacent to an Industrial Zone district.

records.name: Viking Longship
records.summary: Norwegian unique Ancient era naval unit that replaces the Galley. Can pillage enemy coastal lands and capture civilians if adjacent using its coastal raiding ability. 4 Movement Movement while in coastal waters.

records.name: Voi Chiến
records.summary: Vietnamese unique Medieval era ranged unit that replaces the Crossbowman. These units have additional movement and can move after attacking. They are also stronger when defending, more expensive, and have greater sight.

records.name: War Department
records.summary: All units heal up to 20 hit points when they eliminate a unit. Awards +1 Governor Governor Title.

records.name: War-Cart
records.summary: Sumerian unique Ancient era unit. Stronger than all other starting units. No penalties against anti-cavalry units. 4 Movement Movement if this unit starts in open terrain.

records.name: Warak’aq
records.summary: Incan unique Medieval Era unit that replaces the Skirmisher. Stronger at ranged combat than the Skirmisher and +1 additional attack per turn.

records.name: Warlord's Throne
records.summary: Capturing an enemy City grants 20% bonus Production Production in all Cities for 5 turns. Awards +1 Governor Governor Title.

records.name: Warrior Monk
records.summary: Fast-moving land combat unit with a unique promotion tree.

records.name: Water Mill
records.summary: Bonus resources improved by Farms gain +1 Food Food each. City must be adjacent to a River.

records.name: Water Park
records.summary: A district placed out on a coastal tile dedicated to keeping your people happy by increasing Amenities Amenities. Cannot be built in a city with an Entertainment Complex. Cannot be built on Reef.

records.name: Wheat
records.summary: An early growth resource that can support population or be harvested when an immediate production goal is more valuable.

records.name: Wind Farm
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Wind Farm. +2 Gold Gold. +1 Production Production. Provides 2 Power Power per turn. Must be built on Hills terrain.

records.name: Winged Hussar
records.summary: Polish unique Renaissance era unit that replaces the Cuirassier. Pushes defending enemy units back from their hex in any battle where they score more damage. Defenders that cannot retreat suffer additional damage.

records.name: Workshop
records.summary: Begins the Industrial Zone building chain and adds steady Production where it can be converted into meaningful output.

records.name: Ziggurat
records.summary: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Ziggurat, unique to Sumeria. +2 Science Science. +1 Culture Culture if next to River. Cannot be built on Hills but may be built on Floodplains.

records.name: Zombie
records.summary: A hostile melee unit that has a chance to appear on the map at a location where a unit has died. Its Melee Strength increases with each Zombie that has been eliminated, globally. If a Zombie destroys another unit, a new Zombie unit spawns in that tile the next turn. If a Zombie reduces a city's population, a new Zombie unit will spawn immediately next to the city. Zombies target the closest nearby unit, city, or defensible district.

records.name: Zoo
records.summary: Bonus Amenities Amenity extends to each city center within 6 tiles. This bonus applies once to a city, and multiple copies of this building within 6 tiles of a city center do not provide additional bonuses. +1 Science Science to each Rainforest and Marsh tile in this city.
